description: 后翼弃兵兑换变例 D35 — 白方主动cxd5：开放列施压的战略兑换

intro.popup_en:
Timely Exchanges, Lesson 2
In the Queen's Gambit, White's c4-pawn contests Black's d5-pawn. White chooses cxd5 to open the c-file and later place a knight on d5. When is this central exchange most effective?
intro.popup:
及时兑子 第2课

后翼弃兵——白方c4对抗黑方d5
双方中心兵紧张对峙

白方第5手：cxd5！
主动兑换中心兵！

直接结果：c列开放
战略目标：白方利用c列施压，
并在d5放置强马！

⭐ 中心兑换：什么时候cxd5最强？

outro.popup_en: The second exchange pattern: a central exchange opens the c-file, a knight occupies d5, and the minority attack b4-b5 targets Black's queenside weaknesses. Before exchanging, consider which files will open, which outposts will appear, and which pawn weaknesses can be attacked. This is a common professional strategy.
outro.popup:
QGD兑换变例总结

及时兑子的第二模式：

① 中心兑换开放列（c列归白）
② d5成为白方强格（马占d5）
③ 少数兵推进：b4-b5攻击黑方弱点

兑换判断标准：
① c列开放——白方重子可以利用
② d5强格——马的完美位置
③ 少数兵攻击——结构性长期优势

这是职业棋手最常用的战略套路之一！

moves.popup_en: d4 establishes central control.
moves.popup: d4 中央控制

moves.popup_en: ...d5 mirrors White's central occupation.
moves.popup: d5 对称中心

moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit challenges Black's d5-pawn.
moves.popup:
c4！后翼弃兵！
向d5发起挑战

moves.popup_en: ...e6 defends the c4-pawn and prepares to develop the bishop.
moves.popup:
e6 黑方防御c4兵
同时准备出象——后翼弃兵防御

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops and supports the d4-c4 center.
moves.popup: Nc3 发展马，支持d4+c4

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and defends d5.
moves.popup: Nf6 发展马，守护d5

moves.popup_en: Bf4! The London bishop becomes active on the c1-h6 diagonal, part of White's systematic setup.
moves.popup:
Bf4！london象！
象在c1-h6对角线活跃
这是白方的系统性方案

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops conservatively and prepares kingside castling.
moves.popup:
Be7 黑方保守发展
准备短易位

moves.popup_en: e3 supports d4 and prepares White to castle.
moves.popup: e3 巩固d4，准备入城

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup:
O-O 黑方入城
王翼安全

moves.popup_en: cxd5!! White exchanges in the center at the right moment. Black is castled, Bf4 controls c7, and Nc3 is ready to use d5 or e5. The trade opens the c-file for White's rooks.
moves.popup:
cxd5！！白方中心兑换！

⭐ 关键时机——为什么现在？
① 黑方已入城（c列开放后无危险）
② 白方Bf4已就位（可以控制c7）
③ Nc3准备好进入d5或e5

⭐ 兑换创造什么？
c列开放！白方重子可以利用。

moves.popup_en: ...exd5 recaptures. White now has a semi-open c-file, while Black's d5-pawn is isolated and needs protection.
moves.popup:
exd5 黑方用e兵回吃

⭐ 局面变化：
① c列对白方开放（白方半开放c列）
② 黑方d5兵孤立了——没有e兵支持
③ d5兵需要保护！

moves.popup_en: Bd3! The bishop targets h7, supports e4, and develops with tempo.
moves.popup:
Bd3！象占强格！
象从d3瞄准h7，并支持e4
白方发展速度加快

moves.popup_en: ...c6 supports the isolated pawn on d5; this defensive support is important.
moves.popup:
c6 黑方c6支持d5
保护孤立兵——这是关键一步

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops and prepares Ne5, an ideal outpost.
moves.popup:
Nf3！白方马发展
准备Ne5——最强格

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops, supports Nf6, and reinforces the center.
moves.popup:
Nbd7 黑方马发展
支持Nf6，守护中心

moves.popup_en: O-O completes White's development and secures the king.
moves.popup:
O-O 白方入城
所有子力协调

moves.popup_en: ...Re8 places a rook on the e-file and supports a possible ...e5 break.
moves.popup:
Re8 黑车到e列
支持e6-e5的可能反击

moves.popup_en: Qc2! The queen coordinates with Bf4, controls the c-file, and prepares Rac1.
moves.popup:
Qc2！后配合Bf4
控制c列，准备Rac1

moves.popup_en: ...Nf8 reroutes the knight toward g6 to strengthen the defense.
moves.popup:
Nf8 黑马重组
准备Ng6，加强防守

moves.popup_en: Rac1! White occupies the c-file with both rooks coordinated. The plan is the minority attack b4-b5 against the base of Black's c-pawn chain.
moves.popup:
Rac1！车占c列！

⭐ cxd5的成果：
白方重车c1+f1压制c列
白方全部子力协调一致！

⭐ 白方的计划：
b4-b5推进（少数兵攻击！）
攻击c6叠兵链的根部……

moves.popup_en: ...Ne6 enters the center and seeks counterplay.
moves.popup:
Ne6 黑马进入e6
试图反制……

moves.popup_en: Bg5! White offers another exchange: Bxf6 would remove a key defender and weaken Black's kingside. Should White give up the bishop pair for this positional gain?
moves.popup:
Bg5！兑换提议！

⭐ 二次兑换机会：
Bxf6！可以兑换黑方防守马
削弱黑方防守结构

什么时候放弃双象换取位置优势？

moves.popup_en: ...h6 challenges the bishop and asks White to clarify its intention.
moves.popup: h6 黑方质问象的意图

moves.popup_en: Bxf6!! White exchanges the bishop for the defensive knight. White gives up the bishop pair but disrupts Black's defensive structure; after recapturing, Black's kingside is weakened.
moves.popup:
Bxf6！！象换马！

⭐ 第二次战略兑换！
白方放弃双象优势
但破坏了黑方的防守结构！
黑方回吃后王翼变弱

moves.popup_en: ...Bxf6 recaptures, retaining the bishop pair but with structural damage.
moves.popup:
Bxf6 黑方象回吃
维持双象，但结构已受损

moves.popup_en: b4!! White launches the minority attack. White's c-pawn has been exchanged, but b4-b5 targets the c6-pawn chain. The earlier exchanges were made to prepare this plan; every trade served the strategic goal.
moves.popup:
b4！！少数兵进攻！

⭐ 战略精华：
White的c兵不见了（兑换了）
但用少数兵b4-b5攻击c6！
这是cxd5之后的标准计划！

总结：每次兑换都为这一刻服务！
